rebuild.operational_note: A command-timeout overlap created three duplicate SUCCESS audit events, but no duplicate logical documents, versions, records, observations, content units, or provenance rows. Audit rows are execution history, not logical entities.

parser_and_retrieval_findings: HTML-exported XLS inputs are parsed as HTML tables, preserving grid/cell provenance.
Three PDFs have insufficient reliable internal title evidence; their filenames remain physical identity only.
The live deterministic retrieval evaluation before rebuild had Recall@10 0.45299145299145294 and provenance accuracy 0.975.
A complete post-rebuild 40-case measurement was not returned before the environment command limit; no after metric is claimed.

embedding_decision.reason: Measured deterministic retrieval failures include source identification, structured retrieval, cross-document acquisition, and version handling. Embeddings cannot safely correct source-title, metadata, or structured-query defects and must not be used to mask them.
required_before_enablement: Complete post-rebuild deterministic evaluation with verified answer/source ground truth.
Repair generic PostgreSQL retrieval and metadata contracts from measured misses.
Evaluate semantic retrieval independently against the same source-verified cases.
